integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, horizontal 16:9, a cool blue-grey low-saturation grade under pale flat overcast daylight, quiet still melancholic present-day mood. The frame opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a high-angle top-down close insert of a dark blue-grey wooden tabletop. A black smartphone lies flat on the cold dark wood, surrounded by cool-toned props — a dark ceramic mug at the upper left, a dark plate holding dark cherries at the upper right, a crumpled tissue at the lower left, and a folded grey cloth at the lower right. The phone screen is softly lit, showing a warm golden-backlit photograph of a young East Asian Chinese couple: a smiling young woman lying against a young man's back with her wind-tossed hair, both of them laughing warmly in amber light. Preserve the exact tabletop layout, every prop and its position, the phone's placement, and the warm memory photo displayed on the cool surface. The camera holds an almost static top-down shot with only a faint drift. From this starting frame, the screen's warm amber glow gradually brightens and spills a soft pool of warm light across the surrounding cold blue-grey wood, so warm and cool tones share the same frame; no hand enters and no finger touches or taps the phone. After the glow reaches its gentle peak, the screen slowly dims and the warm light recedes, the tabletop settling back to a cold, quiet blue-grey as the shot ends. The corner of the phone screen stays as clean empty blank space. No text, no numbers, no dates, no letters and no characters of any kind appear anywhere on the phone screen or anywhere in the scene. Clean frame with no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no Chinese characters and no watermark anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Deep quiet silence over a very light indoor room tone, broken only by a short soft phone vibration and a single faint notification chime, after which everything settles back into stillness.
